display.title: Soldiers of Hashem vs. the Yetzer Hara: The Seesaw and the Secret of Joy
display.summary_short: A soldier in Hashem's army fights the enemy inside, the yetzer hara. Torah and mitzvos lift the yetzer tov like a seesaw, and being happy is the secret weapon.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that every soldier in Tzivos Hashem must win the battle against an enemy that is not far away: the yetzer hara, the little voice inside that tries to get us to do wrong, while the yetzer tov, our best friend, urges us to learn Torah and do mitzvos. Our secret weapons are Torah and mitzvos. Like a seesaw in the park, our Sages teach, when the yetzer tov goes up the yetzer hara goes down, until it gives up the fight. And here is a secret: the yetzer hara is happiest when it finds a child sad and worried, so serve Hashem with joy. That, says Uncle Yossi, is why every program has a Hakochainik march.
display.lesson: Learn Torah, do mitzvos and stay happy, and the yetzer hara will lose its strength.
